CustomField.description: TRUE when the member held an elected officer role this year (Chair/President/Vice President/Secretary/Treasurer). Officer years pause the 6-year board clock and do not count toward the term limit. JSI-123 / Jason Ott.
CustomField.formula: OR( ISPICKVAL(Role__c, "Chair"), ISPICKVAL(Role__c, "President"), ISPICKVAL(Role__c, "Vice President"), ISPICKVAL(Role__c, "Secretary"), ISPICKVAL(Role__c, "Treasurer") )
CustomField.label: Is Officer Year
